proof_scope: In progress. R1780 proves exact Fourier scaling/translation and translation-correlation Plancherel for actual Schwartz functions, proves integrability of the singular wavelet scale kernel, and bounds positive-scale affine energy by M^(-1)||u||_2^2||v||_2^2 whenever the Schwartz analyzing vector u has Fourier transform zero on |xi|<M, M>0. The test vector v is an arbitrary actual complex L2 vector. Schwartz density and Fatou establish the extended nonnegative integral bound; its finiteness proves genuine Bochner integrability and the real product and iterated integral bounds. The matrix g(s,t)=[[sqrt(s),t/sqrt(s)],[0,1/sqrt(s)]] has determinant one for s>0, and the existing action T_g=W_(g^-1) on u is exactly s^(-1/2)u((x-t)/s). No spatial support or regularity assumption on v is imposed.
